# Noregstoget — Full LLM Reference

Live URL: https://togkartet.msge.no
Source: https://github.com/mmsge/togkartet
License: MIT

## Purpose

Noregstoget ("Norway's train" in Nynorsk) is a browser-based live train map that renders the Norwegian passenger rail network as a schematic, London Tube-style diagram and overlays real-time vehicle positions fetched from Entur's public transport APIs. The goal is to give a clear, always-current view of where trains are across the entire country.

## File structure

```
index.html          — minimal HTML shell; all UI is JS-rendered
app.js              — all application logic (~1 000 lines, Vanilla JS)
style.css           — styling including dark-mode rules
data/network.json   — pre-built schematic network topology
tools/
  build-network.mjs — Node.js script that regenerates network.json from Entur APIs
  serve.mjs         — minimal local dev server (avoids CORS issues)
llms.txt            — LLM-friendly summary (llmstxt.org format)
llms-full.txt       — this file
```

No build step at deploy time. The network data is generated once by `tools/build-network.mjs` and committed. GitHub Actions deploys the static files directly to GitHub Pages.

## data/network.json schema

Top-level keys:

```
{
  "bounds":     { "minX", "maxX", "minY", "maxY" },
  "projection": { "centerLat", "centerLon", "scale" },
  "stations":   { "<name>": StationObject },
  "lines":      [ LineObject ]
}
```

### StationObject

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `x` | number | Schematic x coordinate (integer grid units) |
| `y` | number | Schematic y coordinate (integer grid units, y increases southward) |
| `lat` | number | Real-world WGS84 latitude |
| `lon` | number | Real-world WGS84 longitude |
| `ids` | string[] | Entur NSR StopPlace IDs, e.g. `["NSR:StopPlace:337"]` |
| `bnCode` | string\|null | Bane NOR telegraphic code for rtd.banenor.no; null if unavailable |
| `interchange` | boolean | True if served by more than one line |
| `lines` | string[] | Line IDs that stop at this station |

### LineObject

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string | Kebab-case identifier, e.g. `"bergensbanen"` |
| `name` | string | Display name in Norwegian |
| `color` | string | Hex colour for rendering |
| `tier` | string | `trunk` / `regional` / `commuter` / `branch` — controls zoom-level visibility |
| `serviceLineIds` | string[] | Entur line IDs (`<codespace>:Line:<code>`) mapped to this schematic line |
| `stops` | string[] | Ordered station names (terminals and major interchanges) |
| `polyline` | object[] | `{x, y, station?}` points — includes bend points between named stops |
| `dashed` | object[] | Optional: points for a dashed continuation (e.g. cross-border) |

## Operators and Entur codespaces

| Codespace | Operator | Primary lines |
|-----------|----------|---------------|
| VYG | Vy | Bergensbanen, Dovrebanen (partial), Kongsvingerbanen, Østfoldbanen, Gardermobanen, Randsfjordbanen |
| SJN | SJ Nord | Nordlandsbanen, Dovrebanen (partial), Rørosbanen, Raumabanen, Meråkerbanen, Trønderbanen |
| SJV | SJ Sverige | Ofotbanen (Stockholm–Narvik night train) |
| GOA | Go Ahead Nordic | Sørlandsbanen, Arendalsbanen, Vestfoldbanen, Jærbanen, Bratsbergbanen |
| GJB | Gjøvikbanen AS | Gjøvikbanen (Oslo S–Gjøvik) |
| FLT | FlixTrain | Budget intercity (seasonal) |
| RUT | Ruter | Oslo area (some services on shared infrastructure) |

## Real-time data pipeline

1. Every 15 s, `app.js` fetches the GTFS-RT vehicle positions feed (Protocol Buffer binary) from `https://api.entur.io/realtime/v1/gtfs-rt/vehicle-positions`.
2. If that request fails, it falls back to SIRI-VM (JSON) from `https://api.entur.io/realtime/v1/rest/vm`.
3. Each vehicle entity carries a `tripId` (GTFS-RT) or `journeyRef` (SIRI-VM). The operator codespace is extracted from the first colon-delimited segment.
4. The vehicle's current stop sequence index is interpolated against the schematic line polyline to place a marker at the correct proportional position between stops.
5. Bearing is derived from the interpolated direction vector and used to orient the chevron/arrow icon.
6. Markers are Leaflet `divIcon`s with an SVG element coloured per operator.

## Journey Planner queries (on demand)

When a user clicks a train, `app.js` sends a GraphQL query to `https://api.entur.io/journey-planner/v3/graphql` for:

```graphql
serviceJourney(id: $id) {
  id
  line { publicCode name operator { name } }
  passingTimes {
    quay { name }
    scheduledArrival scheduledDeparture
    expectedArrival expectedDeparture
    realtime
    cancellation
  }
}
```

When a user clicks a station, it queries `estimatedCalls` on the stop place to populate the departure/arrival board (90-second client-side cache).

## Schematic coordinate system

Coordinates use a simple equirectangular projection centred on Norway, implemented via Leaflet `CRS.Simple`. The schematic layout matches a metromapmaker.com diagram (key: TN7q-Qcf). The y-axis is flipped so that north is up on screen. The build script (`tools/build-network.mjs`) auto-positions most stations by:

1. Fetching all stops for each line from the Entur API
2. Filtering to a hand-maintained allowlist of 26 lines
3. Projecting lat/lon to a grid via equirectangular projection centred at approximately 65°N, 15°E
4. Fitting a principal-axis line (PCA) through each line's stops to straighten the schematic
5. Applying hand-authored overrides for the Oslo central area, where many lines converge

## Caching

| Data | TTL |
|------|-----|
| Vehicle positions | 15 s (re-fetched on each interval tick) |
| Journey details (clicked train) | 10 min (sessionStorage) |
| Station departure board | 90 s (in-memory Map) |

## Deployment

- Hosted at `https://togkartet.msge.no` (custom domain pointed at GitHub Pages)
- GitHub Actions workflow in `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`
- Triggers on: push to `hovud` branch or manual `workflow_dispatch`
- No build step — the entire repo root is uploaded as the Pages artifact

## Known limitations

- Not all trains carry GPS transponders; some vehicles will not appear on the map.
- 15-second update cadence is set by the Entur feed refresh rate.
- Some line segments have visible geometry kinks where manual coordinate overrides hand off to auto-positioned stops (notably the RE10/Hovedbanen corridor between Lillestrøm and Hamar).
- Station labels overlap in dense urban clusters at moderate zoom. Only terminal and interchange stations are visible at zoom levels below 3; all stations appear at zoom ≥ 3.
- Cross-border continuation segments (into Sweden via Ofotbanen, Meråkerbanen, Kongsvingerbanen, Østfoldbanen) are shown as dashed lines because Swedish stations are outside the schematic.
- FlixTrain services are seasonal and may not appear outside their operating timetable.
